Prepare sequences for de novo alignment (internal)

Source: R/utils.R
rb_prepare_for_alignment.Rd

Removes alignment padding and whitespace, and converts IUPAC ambiguity codes to N, for algorithms that require an ungapped ACGTN input. Never used to modify stored sequences.

Usage

rb_prepare_for_alignment(sequence)

Arguments

sequence

Character vector.

Value

Character vector of the same length as sequence, uppercased, with alignment padding and whitespace removed and all non-ACGT characters replaced by N.

Details

Intended solely for the input boundary of de novo alignment, where an ungapped ACGTN alphabet is required. Do not apply to already-aligned sequences: gap characters carry the column correspondence between taxa, and removing them invalidates per-column operations such as Biostrings::consensusMatrix() and equal-width distance calculations.
